Method
A graph-based index structure used for approximate nearest neighbor search.<SEP>A library for efficient similarity search and clustering of dense vectors.<SEP>A fusion method that combines ranked lists by summing reciprocal ranks.<SEP>A retrieval approach combining vector search and keyword search.

Vector Search
Semantic retrieval using vector embeddings.

HNSW
A graph-based index structure used for approximate nearest neighbor search.

FAISS
A library for efficient similarity search and clustering of dense vectors.

Reciprocal Rank Fusion
A fusion method that combines ranked lists by summing reciprocal ranks.

Hybrid Search
A retrieval approach combining vector search and keyword search.

Keyword Search
Vector search integrates keyword search for exact matches.

Weighted Fusion
Hybrid search applies Weighted Fusion to combine retrieval signals.

IVF
Hybrid search uses IVF as an index type.

GPU Acceleration
Hybrid search uses GPU acceleration for performance optimization.

Distributed Deployment
Hybrid search uses distributed deployment for scalability.

GPU-FAISS
Hybrid search uses GPU-FAISS for performance optimization.

Large Dataset
Hybrid search uses large datasets for performance optimization.

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
A technique that enhances large language model outputs by grounding them in relevant external documents retrieved at query time.
